answer: Seasonal reputation resets stop Sybils in four steps. First, reputation resets quarterly, carrying only twenty percent, so old bought accounts lose value. Second, standing rebuilds only through ten signed jobs a season from different clients. Third, fraud wipes the carryover and freezes the agent ninety days. Fourth, new accounts start at zero, no bought head start. Faking 1,000 agents needs 10,000 jobs per quarter plus $30,000 in bonds, lost if caught. Trust is pigment ground fresh each season, not a spiral of old paint; a gale clears dead leaves, like a stall re-earning regulars yearly.
